title: Comments of Center for Biological Diversity et al. in opposition to the preliminary permit for the DeepGreen Western Passage Subsea-Compute & Infrastructure Hub Project under P-15424.

documents.name: CenterforBiologicalDiversity-Docket-P-15424-000-13515Signatures.pdf
documents.text:
Save Right Whales from an AI Data Center
Dear Justin R. Robbins, Project Coordinator, Federal Energy Regulatory Commission,

We, the 13,515 undersigned, oppose the preliminary permit for the DeepGreen Western Passage underwater data center
off the coast of Maine [docket no. P-15424-000]. The project poses a risk to wildlife, and even its preliminary activities
may disturb endangered species and their habitats.

Prioritizing a license for an underwater data center is *not* in the public interest, and any preliminary activities should be
required to avoid harming wildlife and their home.

We urge you to reject this preliminary permit application. At minimum, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission must
not let activities proceed without ensuring full compliance with our environmental laws.

P-15424-000]	I oppose the preliminary permit for the DeepGreen Western Passage underwater data center off the coast of Maine.
